editor.elementName: Save Button which saves form data.

props.description:
This table is the list of inventory and it's attributes
Links out to production history and production depletion

props.label: Number
props.description: This is the inventory number - Label field

props.label: Location
props.description: Location is only 'required' for product-strategies that have the "use locations" flag set to True.

fields.name: expirationAt
fields.description: Expiration date set based on origination date + rules defined on Lot control for the product.
fields.label: Expiration At

fields.name: holdUntilAt
fields.description: Hold Date = Origination Date + Hold Days
fields.label: Hold Until At

fields.name: maturityAt
fields.description: Maturity date is origination date + maturity days from lot control setup
fields.label: Maturity At

fields.name: number
fields.description: This is either an autosequence, if lotNumberSchema is Null for the product, or use lotNumberSchema as formula variable to drive lot number.
fields.label: Number

fields.name: originationAt
fields.description: The date the lot is created in the system
fields.label: Origination At

fields.name: expirationActionAt
fields.description: Expiration Action date = Lot Expiration Interval + Lot Expiration Date
fields.label: Expiration Action At

fields.name: fromLot
fields.description: For child lots - will only be availble if Lot Control allows this.
fields.label: From Lot

props.label: Generate FUUZ Serial Number
props.description: Fuuz will generate its own serial number, if this is False, you must provide a Serial Number (i.e. Supplier Serial, Legacy System Serial, etc.)
